description: Use this when a car park operator or analyst asks about the parking market around a European airport: how many car parks compete there, the share offering a shuttle, valet or covered parking, the median and shortest distance to the airport, and how many have published prices. Phrasings: "how many parking competitors at Eindhoven airport", "share of valet parkings at Orly", "concurrence parking aéroport Bordeaux". Data: Park & Keep airport parking index.

airport.description: IATA code (e.g. "BRU") or airport / city name (e.g. "Charleroi", "Málaga").

name: airport_market_snapshot
title: Airport parking market snapshot
